stages.description: AC inlet, fuse, NTC, EMI filter, MOV
stages.fail_note: No AC input reaching the primary. Check the AC inlet, fuse, and NTC. A blown primary fuse indicates a downstream short — do NOT replace without finding it.

stages.description: Bridge rectifier (4 diodes or bridge block)
stages.fail_note: Bridge rectifier fault. Check the bridge for short/open. A shorted bridge blows the primary fuse.
Bulk cap voltage wrong. A shorted bulk cap blows the fuse; an open/degraded cap causes low DC and ripple.
PFC stage fault. Check the PFC switch and the PFC bulk voltage (~380V DC).

stages.description: Controller VCC (internal LDO or external bias)
stages.fail_note: Controller VCC missing. The IC cannot run. Check the VCC decoupling cap and the VCC feed (internal LDO or bias winding).
Controller not enabled or no reference. Check EN source and the internal Vref.

stages.description: Primary switch driving the transformer primary
stages.fail_note: Primary switch fault. Check gate-drive; a dead primary FET gives no energy transfer.

stages.description: Flyback transformer (stores energy in primary, releases to secondary)
stages.fail_note: Transformer/snubber fault. An open primary winding gives no transfer; a shorted winding overheats. Check the RCD snubber across the primary — a failed snubber causes avalanche failure of the primary FET.
Secondary rectifier fault. An open secondary diode blocks output; a short loads the secondary.

stages.description: Isolated feedback: secondary TL431 + optocoupler across isolation barrier
stages.fail_note: Feedback path fault across the isolation barrier. Check the TL431 reference, the optocoupler CTR, and the secondary-side feedback divider. An open optocoupler drives the primary to max duty; a shorted TL431 drives min duty.
PGOOD not asserted or protection tripping. Check the PGOOD pull-up and the OVP/OCP monitors.

fault_patterns.notes: Flyback: isolated feedback (opto) is a common failure.
Flyback overvoltage = open opto (primary drives max duty).
